title: Embeddable debug HUD snippets and compact fallback visuals for quickstart
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Design a compact, embeddable debug HUD and a set of lightweight fallback illustrations/micro-interstitials to surface error states (rate limits, request timeouts, retry status) in the Quickstart experience and docs. Deliverables: Figma components (HUD + toasts + interstitials), localized microcopy variants, export-ready PNG/SVG assets, and a small implementation spec for the frontend team describing animation timings, accessibility requirements, and telemetry hooks.
assets: hud/debug-hud-compact-@1x.svg — sticky micro HUD for quickstart pages (variants: default, warning, error)
toasts/retry-toast-animated.gif — 3-frame retry progress loop, 600ms total duration
icons/rate-limit-badge-24px.svg — small badge used in headers and notifications
copy/microcopy-en-US.csv — final approved strings for quickstart flow
attachments: Recording: https://www.loom.com/share/EXAMPLE — walkthrough of HUD interactions (prototype)
acceptance_criteria: HUD component delivered in Figma with tokenized colors and spacing
Three fallback illustrations (rate-limit, timeout, transient retry) exported as SVG and PNG at required sizes
Microcopy approved by PM and Localization leads (en-US and intl placeholders)
Implementation spec documents animation timings, aria attributes and keyboard behavior
Engineers confirm telemetry flag names and one example integration (DEV staging)
dev_notes: Target max bundle size for HUD CSS should be < 6KB gzip when tree-shaken
Animation durations: toast entry 180ms ease-out, retry spinner loop 600ms linear, interstitial crossfade 220ms
Color tokens must map to existing theme tokens (semantic: --rwd-warning, --rwd-critical, --rwd-neutral)
Provide SVGs with <title> and <desc> for screen readers; fallback PNGs for older browsers
Expose telemetry flags: quickstart.hud.visible (bool), quickstart.hud.variant (enum: default|warning|error), quickstart.hud.retry_count (int)
